title: Binder: canonicalize numeric member names (GetPropertyNameForPropertyNameNode)
description: Upstream names a numeric member by the scanner's canonical value (0b11 binds as '3', 1.0 as '1'; ast/utilities.go:3160 Text() = token value), so duplicate spellings merge into one symbol. Also unblocks the recorded signed-numeric gap in dynamic_name (binder.rs).
